quote.text: we want to bring an ai in but we're not going to fire half the team
one of the biggest things for you to learn in AI is that it's always front loaded
I don't think it's bad enough that I need to start over and I don't think I have time to start over
Please go ahead and codify that as a skill so that if I need to use it again, it's an instant fix.
i've got one session that's just watching all this looking for anything that's like blocked on me
everything's a little bit off the rails and we need to get everything back on the rails
the bottleneck is always always always human

that's fun to learn things in this way
